title: Quran Study 53: October 22, 1982 Original Recording, Intellectual Freedom and al-Fatihah
date_note: Explicit in the filename. This recording precedes and complements Study 54.
source_file: data/sources/playlists/audio-transcripts/53 - Quran Study 22 Oct 1982 By Dr Rashad Khalifa - Original.csv
document_summary: The first portion of an October 22, 1982 study. The opening is a wide-ranging discussion of intellectual decline, Hadith-centered education, the loss of science and philosophy, probability, decision-making, and American consumerism. The study then turns to al-Fatihah. Rashad and Dean Mahmoud map those blessed, those deserving wrath, and the strayers onto the righteous, disbelievers, and hypocrites described at the beginning of Sura 2. The final discussion examines the straight or right path, lexical choices, classical commentaries, and the claim that hypocrites are strayers because they once entered the path and then deviated.

The 1982 source preserves an earlier interpretive stage.

sections.retrieval_note: The historical account is informal and requires independent scholarship.

sections.title: al-Fatihah's three groups and their correspondence with Sura 2
sections.summary: The study interprets those blessed as the righteous, those deserving wrath as disbelievers, and the strayers as hypocrites. The small number of verses devoted to disbelievers and the longer treatment of hypocrites at the beginning of Sura 2 are used to support the mapping.
